**South Africa: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 1,547,654 applications. The largest annual volume was 222,326 in 2009; 2025 recorded 5,324. Applications in 2025 were 89% lower than in 2019 (48,366). In 2025, 22,197 recorded decisions equated to 417 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 25% lower than in 2024 (7,077). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 0 of 4 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Ethiopia (2,148), Dem. Rep. of the Congo (905), Somalia (680).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 17%, across 12,129 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 45% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 5.0 percentage points higher than in 2024 (12%).
